MCP registration: add to ~/.codex/config.toml:

[mcp_servers.founder-vn]
command = "uvx"
args = ["--from", "founder-vn", "founder-vn-mcp"]
tool_timeout_sec = 300

Codex stops a tool call after 60 seconds by default; tool_timeout_sec raises that limit
for long panel jobs.

Model calls read FOUNDER_LLM_BASE_URL, FOUNDER_LLM_API_KEY and FOUNDER_LLM_MODEL from the
host environment. Set them there; never write their values into a config file or the repository.
